name: automate-notification-to-teams
description: Set up Microsoft Teams notifications through a few questions.

interface.shortDescription: Set up Teams notifications through a few questions
interface.longDescription: Choose one message or an ongoing automation. Answer a few questions about the destination, event or schedule, message, and optional link. The plugin guides setup in a connected tool. It checks message delivery and record links when tested.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $automate-notification-to-teams to ask me a few questions and help me set up my Teams notification.
